speakLocalProviderCardDesc: On-device sanoTTS voice that reads assistant answers aloud. Nothing leaves your machine.
speakEnabledDesc: Adds a Speak button under each answer that reads it aloud with the selected voice.
speakLicenseNote: Runtime G2P (espeak-ng) is GPL-3.0; neural inference is MIT. Voices download on demand from ampixa/sanoTTS.
speakLanguageDesc: Filters the voice list. Auto follows the interface language.
speakVoiceDesc: Auto follows the interface language. Each voice is a few megabytes, downloaded the first time you use it.
speakSpeedDesc: Playback rate handed to the model, from 0.50x to 2.00x.
speakPreviewDesc: Speaks this line with the current voice and speed.
speakRuntimeCardDesc: Shared G2P WASM plus the selected voice. Files are verified by SHA-256 before use.
speakVoiceHint: Voice weights for the selected language.
speakDownloadSourceDesc: Preferred mirror for runtime WASM and voice files. Other sources are tried automatically if this one fails.
speakAutoDownloadDesc: When Speak is used before the runtime and voice exist, fetch them automatically and show progress.
speakKeepTracksDesc: Save the audio for each answer, so speaking it again is instant and you can download the recording. Turning this off stops saving new recordings; existing recordings remain until cleared.
speakStoredTracksDesc: WAV files are independent of conversations and remain after a conversation is deleted. Limit: 1 GiB total, 200 MiB per recording; playback continues without saving when full.
